name: VehicleTransportMovementBoard
tagline: Plan, track and inspect every vehicle movement between your sites, auctions, compounds and customers.
description: A complete transport desk app for dealer groups in one PCF control: transport requests, driver and car-transporter planning with daily capacity checks, a drag-and-drop movement board, collection walk-round checks, arrival inspection with damage claims per carrier, and sites & lanes analytics. Works instantly with demo data and connects to canvas collections or data sources, model-driven views and the Power Pages Web API.
features: 8 KPI tiles with drill-down and a 7-day transporter load chart
Planner: transporters x days with car capacity, trade-plate driver row and carrier row; pick or drag, Place here, First free transporter
Over-capacity block with override reason, ready-date and past-date rules, driver daily limit, ETA vs required-by
Kanban board with allowed transitions only
Collection checks (walk-round photos, keys, documents) and arrival inspection (no / minor / major damage) with damage claim event
Late and at-risk detection, missed pickups, inspection outstanding, cost above estimate
Sites & lanes: lead time, cost and damage rate per lane
Search, filter drawer, grouping, bulk delivered / notify / CSV export / delete with undo
Phone layout with bottom bar, day chips and overlay detail; keyboard shortcuts and ARIA
controlType: standard (2 controls: data-set + Power Pages field control)
